hypothesis_zh: 提高 Img2Img strength 会增加水面材质重绘，但也会降低双源干涉机制；0.50 应是当前折中。
single_variable_zh: 只改变 Img2Img strength；程序底图、详细 Canny、ControlNet 0.90、提示词、模型、采样器和种子完全一致。

prompt_parts.scene_identity: Top-down photograph of a shallow ripple tank, locked camera, two synchronized point exciters fixed left and right
prompt_parts.material_goal: translucent blue water, realistic small ripples, subtle reflections, soft laboratory light
prompt_parts.state_delta: two circular wave trains overlap into clear nodal and antinodal bands
prompt_parts.must_preserve: exactly two symmetric sources, concentric outward waves, unchanged rectangular tank

negative_artifacts: text, labels, arrows, user interface, watermark, third wave source, moved sources, ocean shore, boats, giant breaking waves, frozen plastic, metallic rings, engraved grooves, hard neon outlines, duplicated emitters, perspective view, cropped tank, blur
